references.text: God creates mankind in His image and gives them dominion over the earth, which reflects the idea of ruling as mirrored in Jesus' promise of thrones.
God's promise to restore and gather Israel, parallel to the concept of restoration and judgment in Jesus' words.
Isaiah prophesies about the restoration of Israel and the establishment of righteous leaders, similar to the future role of the twelve apostles.
Jesus speaks about the apostles' role in the eternal kingdom, reflecting their future position in Matthew 19:28.
Revelation describes the new Jerusalem with twelve gates and twelve foundations, representing the twelve tribes of Israel and the apostles, resonating with themes of judgment and leadership.
